root_cause.text: The error path in `rzn1_dmamux_route_allocate` fails to release the reference count on the DMA master OF node (`dma_spec->np`) when a route allocation fails after the reference was taken, causing an OF node reference leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `of_node_put(dma_spec->np)` in the new `put_dma_spec_np` label, which is now reached from the `-EBUSY` error case (`goto put_dma_spec_np` instead of previous `goto free_map`), ensuring the reference is dropped before freeing the map. The commit message explicitly states the fix is to "drop the reference taken to the DMA master OF node also on late route allocation failures."
